en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, form Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Aban, from Ismail Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the owned slave is blinded, his master should emancipate him, and it would not be for him that he keeps him’.
